canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON of commitmentPayload with lexicographically sorted object keys, compact separators ',' and ':', arrays preserved in declared order
exclusions: Generated predeploy artifacts/runtime bytecode are excluded to prevent circular commitment.
Execution and consensus genesis output files are excluded because they are generated/ceremony outputs with independent freeze/checksum authority.
Testnet genesis time, validator seed and live endpoint topology are not part of the resident-contract configuration commitment.
Any change to an authority input requires an explicit commitment-version decision and re-materialization of affected Genesis-resident runtimes; silent regeneration under FROZEN_V1 is forbidden.
authority: Global Genesis resident-contract configuration identity for IGenesisInitializable420 / GenesisResidentAccess420
